children: CERo Therapeutics entered a consolidated senior secured promissory note with SRX Global for up to $11.67 million, including an initial $775,665 advance and the consolidation of $5.67 million of prior unsecured notes. The new note bears 10% interest, matures on Oct. 15, 2026, and is secured by the subsidiary’s equity and substantially all assets, with a guaranty from the subsidiary. Concurrently, CERo terminated its prior convertible grid promissory notes held by SRX and Keystone Capital Partners by rolling them into the new facility, with no cash repayment or exit fees. The transaction streamlines CERo’s capital structure and provides working capital to support operations and payables.
